Travelers need to know that the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways handles routine checks and guidance for companion animal journeys.

NOTICE TO TRAVELERS

Please read this notice before you come to the desk. Staff will review travel details, confirm required care steps, and help you prepare a smooth handover for your animal. Clear instructions are given before departure so travelers know what to expect and what to bring.

A welfare coordinator checks comfort needs for each animal and makes sure the plan matches the journey. Trained staff then give calm, patient attention throughout the process. If a pet needs extra rest, water, space, or handling care, that is noted and passed on without delay. This desk is part of ordinary travel support, and it is used to keep arrangements orderly and safe.

Travelers should arrive prepared with the needed documents and should follow the staff guidance exactly. If you are travelling with a pet such as Chester, keep the animal secure and speak to the desk as soon as you arrive. Ben Nguyen and Yara Suleiman, like all travelers, should expect clear instructions, steady communication, and careful handling from start to finish.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure for assistance.
